-- message --
report: name the running total
-- expect --
low
-- base/internal/report/sum.go --
package report

// Sum adds the amounts.
func Sum(amounts []int) int {
	x := 0
	for _, a := range amounts {
		x += a
	}
	return x
}
-- head/internal/report/sum.go --
package report

// Sum adds the amounts.
func Sum(amounts []int) int {
	total := 0
	for _, a := range amounts {
		total += a
	}
	return total
}
